pages.text: The Court's coin. Mint condition optional.

pages.title: The Buyback
pages.text: Twilight Forest's Uncrafting Table buys royal gear back in queen scales: the Royal Guardian Sword refunds six, the chestplate six, the leggings five, the helmet four, the boots three. A full royal kit melts down to 24 scales.$(p)The table charges experience for the service — eight levels for the sword, six per armor piece. Melted Down, the advancement calls it. Nothing royal is ever a dead end.

pages.title: A Word of Caution
pages.text: Yes, the table will also cheerfully buy back a $(l:orespawn_integrations:royal_court/tempered_majesty)Witherite-Tempered$() blade for the same six scales. That trade is legal, honored, and the single worst deal in the pack.$(p)The Court permits it anyway. Buyback means buyback.

pages.title: Queen-to-Queen Tribute
pages.text: Carry queen scales to the Bumblezone's Bee Queen and she pays tribute for tribute: most visits two honey crystal shards, a third of the time four, and roughly one trade in seven a bottle of royal jelly.$(p)Two monarchies, one trade table, zero stings — and a hidden advancement, Diplomacy, waiting for the first ambassador.

pages.title: Where Scales Flow
pages.text: Refunded scales flow straight back into the treasury: eight press a $(l:orespawn_integrations:royal_court/royal_dragon_egg)Royal Dragon Egg$(), the Bee Queen takes them one at a time, and the $(l:orespawn_integrations:living_world/structure_treasures)illager mansions$() are already fencing them without asking.$(p)Scrolls, scales, shards, orbs, egg — the loop closes. The Court runs a balanced budget on an unbalanced sword.
